functions.name: CreateCatalogSearcher
documentation: Creates a new instance of a HousingCatalog searcher; This can be used to asynchronously search/filter the HousingCatalog without affecting/being restricted by the filter state of other Housing Catalog UI displays

functions.name: DestroyEntry
documentation: Attempt to delete the entry from storage

arguments.name: destroyAll
documentation: If true, deletes all entries within the stack; If false, will only delete one

functions.name: GetAllVariantInfosForEntry
documentation: Returns variant info for all variants of a given catalog entry; Variants represent different visual modifications of the same base entry (ex: dyed versions)

functions.name: GetCatalogCategoryAndSubcategoryNames
documentation: If found, returns the names of the parent category and the specified subcategory

arguments.name: itemInfo
documentation: ItemID, name, or link of an item that grants/corresponds to a particular type of housing catalog object (ex: decor)

functions.name: GetDecorMaxOwnedCount
documentation: Returns the maximum total number of decor that can be in storage/in the house chest; Note that not all decor entries in storage count towards this limit (see GetDecorTotalOwnedCount)

returns.name: totalOwnedCount
documentation: The total number of owned decor in storage, including both exempt and non-exempt decor

returns.name: exemptDecorCount
documentation: The number of decor that do not count against the max storage limit

functions.name: GetDestroyableInstanceCount
documentation: Returns the number of instances that can be to be destroyed in storage; These instances count towards the max storage limit

functions.name: GetMarketInfoForDecor
documentation: Returns market info for a specific decor. This is decor-only for now but should be extended to support entry type and recordID generically

fields.name: canPreview
documentation: Bundles containing non-decor items cannot be previewed

fields.name: anyStoredEntries
documentation: True if the player owns anything that falls under this category

tables.name: HousingCatalogEntryInfo
documentation: Base information about an object in the Catalog; For info for a specific owned stack of this object, see HousingCatalogEntryVariantInfo

fields.name: asset
documentation: 3D model asset for displaying in the UI; May be nil if the entry doesn't have a model, or has one that isn't supported by UI model scenes

fields.name: iconTexture
documentation: Entry icon in the form of a texture file; Catalog entries should have either this OR an iconAtlas set

fields.name: iconAtlas
documentation: Entry icon in the form a texture atlas element; Catalog entries should have either this OR an iconTexture set

fields.name: uiModelSceneID
documentation: Specific UI model scene ID to use when previewing this entry's 3D model; If not set, the default catalog model scene is used

fields.name: dataTagsByID
documentation: Simple localized 'tag' strings that are primarily used for things like categorization and filtering

fields.name: placementCost
documentation: How much of the applicable budget placing this entry would cost (if any)

fields.name: totalNumStored
documentation: The total number of instances of this entry that exist in storage across all variants; Does not include unredeemed instances (see remainingRedeemable)

fields.name: remainingRedeemable
documentation: The number of unredeemed instances of this entry that exist in storage; Some auto-awarded housing objects are granted in this 'lazily-instantiated' way, and will be 'redeemed' on first being placed

fields.name: totalNumPlaced
documentation: The total number of instances of this entry that have been placed across all of the player's houses and plots, across all variants

fields.name: destroyableInstanceCount
documentation: The number of instances that can be destroyed for this entry.

fields.name: isUniqueTrophy
documentation: This decor is flagged to display as a unique trophy item.

fields.name: isAllowedOutdoors
documentation: True if this entry is something that is allowed to be placed outside, within a plot

fields.name: isAllowedIndoors
documentation: True if this entry is something that is allowed to be placed indoors, within a house interior

fields.name: canCustomize
documentation: True if this entry is something that can be customized; Kinds of customization vary depending on the entry type

fields.name: firstAcquisitionBonus
documentation: House XP that can be gained upon acquiring this entry for the first time

fields.name: sourceText
documentation: Describes specific sources this entry may be gained from; Faction-specific sources may or may not be included based on the current player's faction

tables.name: HousingCatalogEntryVariantInfo
documentation: Represents a single stack of instances of an object in the Catalog, that are all of a specific variation; For example, a stack of undyed chairs, or blue-dyed tables

fields.name: numStored
documentation: The number of instances of this specific variant that exist in storage

fields.name: dyeSlots
documentation: Dye slot information for this variant; Empty for entries that can't be dyed

fields.name: anyStoredEntries
documentation: True if the player owns anything that falls under this subcategory

fields.name: withStoredEntriesOnly
documentation: If true, search will only return categories/subcategories that the player has something stored under

fields.name: editorModeContext
documentation: If set, will restrict results to only categories associated with/used by this Editor Mode
